basis_note: Committed scans are schema_version 2 (no exit.rrRiskBasis). Their stored rrRatio / rrContribution use the pre-D5 premium-stop basis (exit - premium) / (0.60 x premium). Neither today's frontend nor backend loads them. No stored rrRatio is compared with a shipped R/R; both R/Rs below are on the current full-premium basis.

alternatives_exit_recovery_supplementary.note: Non-Heston alternatives: the stored exit premium back-solved from the stored pre-D5 rrRatio (interval from its 2 dp rounding, +-$0.01) against the shipped estimate_rr BS exit premium. Exit premiums are compared, never R/Rs.

limits: Cards store no Heston parameters, fit error or calibration chain: M1 cannot reproduce a Heston number and cannot evaluate any option. It reports reach and the exit gap only.
